tools.name: list_shift_examples
tools.description: List the built-in example rostering problems (hospital ward, 3-shift plant, security post, fire station, 24/7 help desk). Use one as a starting point for the user's own roster.

tools.name: get_shift_example
tools.description: Return the full input JSON of one example, in exactly the shape build_shift_roster accepts. Edit it (names, days, headcounts, rules) to match the user's situation.

tools.name: build_shift_roster
tools.description: Solve a staff rostering problem to optimality with a MILP solver and return who works which shift each day, coverage, unfilled posts, hours per person and warnings. Solves take 5-60 s. Pass either `example` (to solve a built-in example as-is) or the roster input fields. If the result has status 'run

tools.name: get_shift_roster_result
tools.description: Fetch the result of a build_shift_roster job that returned status 'running'. Waits up to wait_seconds; call again while status is 'running'. Jobs expire 15 minutes after they finish.

tools.name: check_request
tools.description: Describe what the user wants in plain words and get back whether this server can do it, which limits it would hit, and the closest thing it CAN do. Instant, no solve. Use it when unsure the tool fits (shift swaps, payroll, time clocks, very large teams or long horizons).

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "build_shift_roster" is 1154 chars, far longer than this server's median (182). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_shift_examples · Public sink: list_shift_examples.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_shift_examples · Public sink: list_shift_examples

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "build_shift_roster" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
